sections.title: باب 7 — متن (57)

paras.text: Immediately after the centre pass every player can start throwing the ball within his own fixed limits.
paras.urdu: سنٹر پاس کے فوراً بعد ہر کھلاڑی اپنی مقررہ حدود کے اندر بال پھینکنا شروع کر سکتا ہے۔

paras.text: After the interval the same player will take the centre pass who took the centre pass before the game stopped, provided there was no goal.
paras.urdu: وقفے کے بعد وہی کھلاڑی سنٹر پاس لے گا جس نے کھیل بند ہونے سے پہلے سنٹر پاس لیا ہو بشرطیکہ گول نہ ہوا ہو۔

paras.text: When some player, with or without the ball, goes into some area other than his own area, he will be off side.
paras.urdu: جب کوئی کھلاڑی گیند یا گیند کے بغیر اپنے علاقے کے علاوہ کسی دوسرے علاقہ میں چلا جائے تو وہ آف سائیڈ ہوگا۔
paras.pashto: کله چې کوم لوبغاړی له توپ سره یا بې توپه له خپلې سیمې پرته بلې سیمې ته لاړ شي، اف سایډ دی.

paras.text: When some part of the body of a player touches another area other than his own area, then too he will be off side.
paras.urdu: جب کسی کھلاڑی کے جسم کا کوئی حصہ اپنے علاقے کے علاوہ دوسرے علاقے کو چھو جائے تو وہ بھی آف سائیڈ ہوگا۔

paras.urdu: گیند کا کورٹ سے باہر جانا (Ball out of court)
paras.pashto: له میدان د توپ وتل (Ball out of court)

paras.text: The ball touches the ground outside the court.
paras.urdu: گیند کورٹ سے باہر زمین کو چھوئے۔
paras.pashto: توپ له میدان بهر ځمکه ولمسوي.

paras.text: The ball touches some person or thing outside the court.
paras.urdu: گیند کورٹ سے باہر کسی شخص یا چیز کو لگے۔
paras.pashto: توپ له میدان بهر کوم کس یا شي ته ولګېږي.

paras.text: When the ball is in the player’s hand and he touches the ground outside.
paras.urdu: جب گیند کھلاڑی کے ہاتھ میں ہو اور وہ باہر زمین کو چھولے۔
paras.pashto: کله چې توپ د لوبغاړي په لاس کې وي او بهر ځمکه ولمسوي.

paras.text: When the ball goes out of the court, then to bring it into the game again a throw-in will be given to the opposing team.
paras.urdu: جب بال کورٹ سے باہر چلی جائے تو اُسے دوبارہ کھیل میں لانے کیلئے مخالف ٹیم کو تھرو ان دی جائے گی۔
paras.pashto: کله چې توپ له میدان ووځي، بیا لوبې ته د راوستلو لپاره مخالف ټیم ته تھرو ان ورکول کېږي.

sections.theory:
Both feet of the player taking the centre pass should be in the circle. At the time of the pass one foot can be kept outside.

The opposing centre can stand anywhere in the centre third at a distance of 3 metres.

Immediately after the centre pass every player can start throwing the ball within his own fixed limits.

After the interval the same player will take the centre pass who took the centre pass before the game stopped, provided there was no goal.

Off side

When some player, with or without the ball, goes into some area other than his own area, he will be off side.

When some part of the body of a player touches another area other than his own area, then too he will be off side.

A player, remaining in his own area, can take the ball from another area by stretching the hand. This will not be off side, but the condition is that while doing so he does not touch the other area.

Penalty

A free pass will be given to the opposing team from the place of the off side. The free pass will be taken by that player who is authorised to go into that area.

Ball out of court

The ball touches the ground outside the court.

The ball touches some person or thing outside the court.

When the ball is in the player’s hand and he touches the ground outside.

Throw in

When the ball goes out of the court, then to bring it into the game again a throw-in will be given to the opposing team.
